🌷About me

Hi, I'm Lana! Photography is my way of slowing down. I carry my camera on walks, trips to the coast and even on the way through my own village, because good light can show up anywhere.

This corner is where I collect my favourite shots. Tap a topic below to find out what I love to shoot.

💗What I love to shoot

Four things that always make me reach for my camera. Tap a card to read more.

🌿

Nature walks

Forests, ferns and quiet trails.

Green light and tall trees make me slow down. I look for leaves with the sun behind them.

🌅

Golden hour

Warm light just before sunset.

The hour before sunset is my favourite time to shoot. Everything looks softer and glows.

🌊

Sea views

Islands, coves and blue water.

Summer trips to the coast give me endless views. I look for a high spot to see the whole bay.

👟

Little details

Shoes, textures and reflections.

Sometimes the best photo is at your feet. Puddles, stones and sneakers all tell a small story.

🎞️Behind the lens

A few things I've learned while taking these photos. Tap a question to open it.

Why do I love golden hour?

The light is soft and warm, and it turns ordinary scenes into something glowing. Shooting into the sun through leaves or an arch adds natural frames and flare.

How do I shoot black & white?

I look for strong contrast: dark silhouettes against bright sky, or reflections in water. Shapes matter more than colour, so I simplify the scene.

What's the story of the puddle photo?

I got down low, close to the ground, so the whole village and its church tower appear twice. Changing your height can completely change a photo.

What do I do with detail shots?

I like playing with edits too. The sneaker photo has a glitchy stretch effect that turns a simple street scene into something more abstract.
